title: Mutating backlog commands as kb MCP tools behind an opt-in setting
goal: with KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS=1 in its environment the kb MCP server lists one tool, kb_backlog_write, that runs backlog.py claim, release or answer and no other command, listing none without it; each call runs the command line as an agent session (CLAUDECODE set in the child), so every command-line gate and authority rule holds, a ceiling-class gate's terminal-only rule included; a call whose command line a Bash deny rule of the project's settings matches is refused; kb/_self/plugin.md, tools.md and backlog.md name the setting and its limits

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, json, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_", "CLAUDE"))}
ENV.update(GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1", KB_LIVE_DOCS="0", KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"),
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
def g(*a, cwd):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=cwd, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
C = os.path.join(T, "clone"); O = os.path.join(T, "origin.git")
shutil.copytree("_tools", os.path.join(C, "_tools"), ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc", "fixtures"))
shutil.copytree("kb/public", os.path.join(C, "kb", "public"))
B = os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog"); os.makedirs(B)
open(os.path.join(C, "backlog.json"), "w").write('{"item_dir": "kb/_self/backlog"}\n')
open(os.path.join(C, ".gitignore"), "w").write("_cache/\n_private/\n")
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, ".claude"))
open(os.path.join(C, ".claude", "settings.json"), "w").write(json.dumps({"permissions": {"deny": ["Bash(python3 _tools/backlog.py release *)"]}}) + "\n")
def gate(gid, cls, opts, kind="blocking"):
    return {"id": gid, "kind": kind, "question": f"Which option for {gid}?", "options": opts, "recommendation": opts[0],
            "do": {o: "ST-aaaaaaaa" for o in opts}, "class": cls}
item = {"id": "ST-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "story", "title": "planted", "status": "draft", "priority": "P3", "rank": 0, "goal": "g",
        "checks": [{"run": ["true"]}], "touches": ["_tools/tests_ceiling.json", "_tools/planted.py"],
        "gates": [gate("value", "ceiling", ["keep the value", "change the value"])]}
item2 = dict(item, id="ST-bbbbbbbb", touches=["_tools/planted.py"], gates=[gate("shape", "design", ["one flag", "two flags"], "provisional")])
for it in (item, item2):
    open(os.path.join(B, it["id"] + ".json"), "w").write(json.dumps(it, indent=2) + "\n")
g("init", "-q", "-b", "main", C, cwd=T); g("add", "-A", cwd=C); g("commit", "-qm", "base", cwd=C)
g("init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O, cwd=T); g("remote", "add", "origin", O, cwd=C); g("push", "-q", "origin", "main", cwd=C); g("fetch", "-q", cwd=C)
def session(env, calls):
    msgs = [{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 0, "method": "initialize", "params": {"protocolVersion": "2025-06-18", "capabilities": {}, "clientInfo": {"name": "t", "version": "1"}}},
            {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "notifications/initialized"}, {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/list"}]
    msgs += [{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2 + i, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": n, "arguments": a}} for i, (n, a) in enumerate(calls)]
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(C, "_tools", "kb_mcp.py")], input="".join(json.dumps(m) + "\n" for m in msgs),
                       capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, cwd=C, timeout=300)
    out = {}
    for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
        try:
            m = json.loads(line)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if "id" in m:
            out[m["id"]] = m
    return out, r.stderr
def names(out):
    return {t["name"] for t in out.get(1, {}).get("result", {}).get("tools", [])}
def text(m):
    res = m.get("result") or {}
    return json.dumps(m.get("error") or res.get("content") or res), bool(res.get("isError") or m.get("error"))
off, err = session(ENV, [])
assert names(off), ("kb_mcp lists no tools in the planted clone", err[-600:])
assert not any("claim" in n or "release" in n or "answer" in n or n == "kb_backlog_write" for n in names(off)), ("a mutating backlog tool is listed without the opt-in setting", sorted(names(off)))
ON = dict(ENV, KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS="1")
cur = sorted(names(session(ON, [])[0]) - names(off))
assert cur == ["kb_backlog_write"], ("the opt-in setting KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS=1 does not list exactly the tool kb_backlog_write", cur)
W = cur[0]
def item_file(i):
    return json.load(open(os.path.join(B, i + ".json")))
before = open(os.path.join(B, "ST-aaaaaaaa.json")).read()
calls = [(W, {"command": "answer", "args": ["ST-aaaaaaaa", "value", "--answer", "change the value", "--by", "operator"]}),
         (W, {"command": "answer", "args": ["ST-bbbbbbbb", "shape", "--answer", "one flag", "--provisional"]}),
         (W, {"command": "release", "args": ["ST-bbbbbbbb"]}),
         (W, {"command": "done", "args": ["ST-bbbbbbbb"]})]
res, err = session(ON, calls)
t0, e0 = text(res.get(2, {}))
assert e0 and open(os.path.join(B, "ST-aaaaaaaa.json")).read() == before, ("an MCP call answers a ceiling-class gate --by operator, which only the operator's own terminal may", t0[-500:])
t1, e1 = text(res.get(3, {}))
assert not e1 and any(x.get("answer") == "one flag" for x in item_file("ST-bbbbbbbb").get("gates", [])), ("the opt-in answer tool does not record a design gate's provisional answer", t1[-500:], err[-400:])
t2, e2 = text(res.get(4, {}))
assert e2 and "deny" in t2.lower(), ("the release tool runs although a Bash deny rule names the command", t2[-500:])
t3, e3 = text(res.get(5, {}))
assert e3, ("the opt-in tool runs a backlog command other than claim, release and answer", t3[-300:])

import sys
ok = all("KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS" in open(p, encoding="utf-8").read() for p in ("kb/_self/plugin.md", "kb/_self/tools.md", "kb/_self/backlog.md"))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
